steps.note: Open the single-stage create screen specified by the case.
Prevent vendor additions during event creation as required by the case.
Set the ceiling-price feature to read-only/off for this scenario.
Apply the case's required terms-and-conditions configuration.
Set the event type to RFQ on the single-stage screen.
Provide the mandatory event title needed to prepare a valid create screen.
Choose the available RFQ pricing template before adding the product.
Add the named product and set its quantity to 10.
Render and populate the RFQ pricing sheet after adding the product.
Verify the product quantity is 10 before testing the ceiling-price control.
